verdict.rationale: Temporal documents first-class versioning. Worker Versioning tags Workers and rolls them out as versioned deployments, so old code paths keep serving in-flight executions while new executions use updated code. A community user also describes resetting a workflow's execution to an earlier point after deploying new code. Because Temporal is Workflows-as-Code, review happens through ordinary code tooling, but the evidence never documents it, and it never explicitly describes rolling a deployment back to a prior version. missing for 10: an explicit documented rollback of automations to a previous version, a documented review or diff workflow for automation changes, and independent hands-on corroboration of versioning or rollback.
